test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pilots are cutes. 

All ballers are cutes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All cutes are ballers.

II. Some pilots are ballers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fac77131fa6503c34e6b02dee24766c318773b12cdd1e749a0616402b389e781.png] 

 

Conclusions:

I. All cutes are ballers → Does not follow (As some pilots are cutes. So, it is possible but not definitely true therefore it does not follow)

II. Some pilots are ballers → Does not follow (As some pilots are cutes, all ballers are cutes. So, it is definitely false as there is not direct relation between pilots and ballers therefore it does not follow)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows..

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follows**".
